# Briefly.live — iOS App Portfolio by Ashwin Anbazhagan

> Six indie iOS apps across gut health, studying, GLP-1 tracking, morning journaling, women's 75-day challenges, and fandom. Each app solves one specific problem precisely. All built by Ashwin Anbazhagan.

## Apps
- [GutPal](https://briefly.live/gutpal): AI gut-health meal planner for IBS, IBD, SIBO, and low-FODMAP diets. Tell it what's in your kitchen and it builds a week of gut-safe meals, aligned with Monash FODMAP research. Also scans menus and barcodes.
- [Masterly AI](https://briefly.live/masterly): Upload your syllabus or notes, get a day-by-day AI study plan with auto-generated flashcards and quizzes. Your apps stay locked via iOS Screen Time until you pass the day's quiz.
- [Honestly](https://briefly.live/honestly): A structured morning ritual — mood check-in, an adaptive journal prompt, and gratitude — that blocks distracting apps until you finish. A plant grows as your streak builds.
- [Shotly](https://briefly.live/shotly): GLP-1 injection and weight-loss tracker for Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, and Zepbound. Logs doses, dose escalation, weight trend, nutrition, side effects, and progress photos. Private and on-device.
- [YumeShip](https://briefly.live/yumeship): A private, on-device creative vault for fans — ships, F/Os, and comfort characters. Write love letters, organize headcanons, track dates. Nothing leaves your device.
- [Her 75](https://briefly.live/her75): A 75-day challenge tracker made for women. Choose your hard — from a gentle reset to the full 75 — log daily missions with proof photos, keep your streak with missed-day recovery, and finish with friends.

## Guides & Comparisons
- Each app has in-depth guide and comparison pages at /{app}/guide/{slug} and /{app}/compare/{slug}, covering specific use cases, conditions, and competitor comparisons.
